faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.question: Which payment methods do you offer?
items.answer: Payment is processed securely via our payment service provider Stripe with the payment methods shown during checkout.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Delivery time is usually 2–4 business days after receipt of payment. Details can be found on the Shipping & Delivery page.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, within the scope of our statutory right of withdrawal you can return items within 14 days. Details can be found on the returns page.

items.question: How can I reach you?
items.answer: Via our contact form, by email at info@fhhandle.de or by phone at +49 1573 0222293.

items.question: Are the refurbished products tested?
items.answer: Yes, all refurbished products are technically tested before sale and delivered in working condition.

agb.title: General Terms and Conditions
agb.s1body: These General Terms and Conditions apply to all orders placed via the online shop of FH IT & Mobile Handel, Feisal Ibrahim Hussein, Siebenbürger Str. 21, 33609 Bielefeld.
agb.s2body: The presentation of products in the shop does not constitute a legally binding offer, but an invitation to place an order. By submitting the order, you make a binding offer to purchase. The purchase contract is concluded through our confirmation or the shipment of the goods.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.s1pre: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
datenschutz.s2body: This website is hosted by an external hosting provider (Vercel Inc.). When you visit the website, information such as IP address, date and time of the request, browser type and operating system is automatically collected in so-called server log files. This data serves to ensure trouble-free operation and the security of our information technology systems (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).
datenschutz.s3body: When you create a customer account or place an order, we process the data required for this (e.g. name, email address, delivery address, order data) for contract processing (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR). Customer accounts are managed via the service provider Supabase.
datenschutz.s4body: We use the payment service provider Stripe to process payments. The payment data required for this is transmitted directly to Stripe and processed there in accordance with Stripe's privacy policy (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR).
datenschutz.s5body: You have the right at any time to information, correction, deletion or restriction of the processing of your personal data, as well as a right to data portability and objection. Please contact the contact address above for this purpose. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

widerruf.title: Withdrawal Policy
widerruf.s1p1: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day on which you or a third party named by you, who is not the carrier, took possession of the goods.
widerruf.s1pre: To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us
widerruf.s1post: by means of a clear statement (e.g. a letter sent by post or an email) of your decision to withdraw from this contract.
widerruf.s2p1: If you withdraw from this contract, we must repay all payments we have received from you without delay and at the latest within fourteen days from the day on which we received notification of your withdrawal from this contract. We may withhold repayment until we have received the goods back or until you have provided proof that you have returned the goods, whichever is earlier.
widerruf.s2p2: You must return the goods to us without delay and in any case no later than fourteen days from the day on which you inform us of the withdrawal from this contract. The deadline is met if you send the goods before the period of fourteen days has expired. You bear the direct costs of returning the goods.
widerruf.s3heading: Exclusion of the right of withdrawal
widerruf.s3body: The right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for the delivery of goods that are not prefabricated and for whose production an individual selection or determination by the consumer is decisive, nor to sealed goods that are not suitable for return for reasons of health protection or hygiene if their seal has been removed after delivery.
